svg.title: Project bays: Ataleir, Drishti, Magi, NeetCode log
svg.desc: ATALEIR: Spoiler-free hints for story games, as a Windows overlay.; ANTARCTIC NAVIGATION: Sea ice forecasting and route planning for polar research vessels.; DRISHTI: Cash-flow early warning for rural micro-enterprises.; PLOT TWIST: Turns one line of premise into a short story, then mutates it on demand.
